roles.purpose: One-time or controlled creation/repair of explicitly approved execution roles and trust/policy attachments.
roles.scope: named target account/tenant/project and explicit role identifiers
constraints: no self-escalation
no wildcard administrator default
policy boundary and organization restrictions must be inspected
privilege changes require explicit approval
cannot silently assume an unconfigured principal

roles.purpose: Authenticate the Ugondu client/CI actor and discover approved targets; orchestrate requests.
constraints: read-only discovery plus narrowly defined assume-role/federation operations
trust conditions bind issuer audience repository/environment/subject where applicable
no default workload provisioning permissions
no arbitrary iam:PassRole

roles.purpose: Apply only approved, target-bound deployment plan operations.
roles.scope: approved account/tenant/project, region, resource family, resource names/tags, and operation set
constraints: policy permissions are derived from the approved plan
resource constraints required where supported
explicit deny and permissions boundary/SCP/tenant policy must be respected
time-bound session and session tags where supported
no role chaining beyond configured trust graph

roles.purpose: Provider-native infrastructure orchestrator service role (for example CloudFormation execution role) when supported and required.
roles.scope: approved stack/project and exact approved service-role ARN/identity
constraints: runner may pass only approved service roles to named services
service role has only the resources/actions required by the reviewed plan
separate from runner and workload runtime identities

roles.purpose: Identity used by the deployed application after provisioning.
constraints: runtime data-plane access only
never reuse bootstrap/execution identity
no provisioning or IAM administration permissions by default

roles.purpose: DNS and certificate lifecycle operations when separately delegated.
roles.scope: approved hosted zones, record names, certificate domains, and regions
constraints: prove zone/domain ownership
protect existing records
reversible change set and read-back
CloudFront viewer certificate in us-east-1 when AWS CloudFront is targeted

roles.purpose: Manage IaC state, artifacts, deployment evidence and backups.
roles.scope: dedicated state/artifact/evidence containers and required key operations
constraints: encryption at rest and in transit
state locking and versioning where supported
no secret values in logs/evidence
least-privilege read/write separation

roles.purpose: Read back resources, status, policy/trust attachments, events and evidence after mutation.
roles.scope: approved target and relevant resource families
constraints: read-only
must verify effective state, not merely API acceptance
verification failure prevents success certification

role_binding_rules: Each execution must bind every selected role to provider, tenant/account/project, partition, region, namespace, environment and plan digest as applicable.
Provider adapters may omit unsupported scope dimensions only with an explicit capability declaration and documented compensating control.
A missing role, missing trust, permission boundary, SCP, policy attachment, or required read permission is an AUTHORITY_GAP, not an invitation to broaden access.

The same identity may fulfill multiple logical roles only if the provider permits it, the plan explicitly records the collapse, and independent policy checks prove no privilege expansion; default is separation.
Never generate universal wildcard resource/action grants as a fallback for an unknown resource or provider.
Role and policy artifacts must be deterministic, versioned, digest-bound, schema-valid, provider-valid, and reviewed before installation.
